question:
Identify the figure given in the options which when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0c6ab60b8f5cd4ec92b75027c110fe9b0e8b86a46716aa8868cc064e42b9952.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) Arrow element → Shift 45º clockwise. 

2) Letter 'A' element → Shift anticlockwise. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7aec7b7a4a1c178cb0093c143e24c750230eb5475ac0e0040145e9ed7124e2ef.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c71ea8e4af834479d5332380bbb8692ea5b0b6b2a3bfceeb87bf050c9bcd769.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
